text:
Sarah: Quick follow-up from today's All-hands infra segment — dropping Qs here so leadership/eng can answer as we have time.
Sarah: TL;DR: region rollout for H100s, autoscaler burst behavior, and owned capacity SLAs.
Mike: Happy to take infra questions. On H100 rollout: US-East pilot in June, EU in July, APAC experimental in August. No exact dates yet.
Raj: Will H100 be default for Hosted/ Dedicated or opt-in?
Mike: Hosted -> will auto-upgrade for latency-sensitive models; Dedicated customers can pin model/gpu families (config will be in Console).
Anne: For Dedicated customers with contracts, is burst capacity guaranteed during peak?
Jess: Contracts will include a committed baseline + optional burst pool with SLO-backed minutes. Pricing TBD per region.
Raj: Regarding fallbacks: if H100 capacity exhausted, what's the automatic fallback chain?
Mike: Fallback chain: H100 -> A100-80GB -> A100-40GB -> mixed CPU fallback (higher latency). We plan per-tenant preferences and cost-aware routing.
Sarah: Any changes to autoscaler behavior for short spikes? We saw sustained cold-start latency on short-lived bursts.
Mike: Autoscaler tune: aggressive warm pools for models with high QPS variance; new "burst-cache" avoids full initialization for short spikes (<30s). Will push config next week.
Alex: Can we see sample autoscaler config? (also want `kubectl` snippet)
Mike: paste:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 50
  warm_pool:
    enabled: true
    size_percent: 20
  burst_cache_ttl: 30s
```
Mike: And the `kubectl` debug command we used:
```
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o wide
```
devops-bot: New runbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/burst-fallbacks
Anne: For product planning — any change to model catalog by default (we use cheaper A100 for embeddings)?
Jess: Yes — embedding workloads will default to A100-40 unless customer pins H100 for latency-sensitive embeddings.
Raj: How will we communicate region-specific availability to users? Need a realtime signal in Console.
Mike: Console roadmap: region status + capacity hints (beta) by end of Q2; API flag for "preferred_region" next sprint.
Sarah: Action items? summary pls.
Jess: I'll collate: 1) publish H100 rollout ETA per region; 2) autoscaler config bake & doc; 3) Dedicated burst SLO draft; 4) Console capacity hints. Will post docs in #eng-infra by Friday.
Sarah: Thanks! :raised_hands:
Mike: ping @Raj for the workload samples you promised
Raj: sending sample traces shortly.
infra-bot: Deploy successful: runtime v2.14 rolled out to us-east at 2168001450
Sarah: Closing thread — great questions. If you need a deeper conversation, open a follow-up in eng-infra or schedule time with Mike/Jess.
